messages:
sara: Kicking off v2.4.0-lite regional deploy. Sequence: US canary -> EU canary -> APAC slow drip. Change windows: US 02:00-04:00 UTC, EU 03:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 12:00-14:00 UTC. Fallback: pin region to prior stable (v2.3.5) if triggers fire.

mike: Got it. Warm-pool status?

ops-oncall: Warm-pool snapshot: US 140G (target 120G), EU 85G (target 100G), APAC 55G (target 80G). APAC short ~25G.

leo: For APAC, we'll need burst-autoscale and q8 fallback. Recommend +30m burst window.

anita: EU has a maintenance job at 03:05 UTC. Propose delay EU canary 8m to avoid noisy metrics.

sara: Delay EU 8m. US canary start now. deploy-bot kick it off.

deploy-bot: Starting US canary -> slices: us-west1/us-east1 traffic=12% pinned_model=v2.4.0

mike: US canary warm: p95=118ms, err_rate=0.5%, GPU_reserve=86%.

leo: Noting a slight quality dip on long-context tests (~3.7%). Below hold threshold (6%).

anita: Run synthetic long-context smoke (150 samples) before EU starts.

deploy-bot: Synthetic eval started eval_id=eval-3234567890 samples=150

deploy-bot: Synthetic eval done quality_drop=3.9% -> pass.

sara: EU canary go in 2m. Anita prep pin notes to v2.3.5.

deploy-bot: Starting EU canary -> slices: eu-west1/eu-central1 traffic=7% pinned_model=v2.4.0

mike: EU warm: p95=137ms err_rate=0.4% GPU_reserve=80%. Smoke set results healthy.

ops-oncall: Enabling APAC burst autoscale for 30m starting +3m. Condition to start drip: warm-pool>=70G or burst on.

sara: APAC drip on burst only. Plan: initial 2% -> +2% every 10m, fallback routing to q8 if GPU_reserve>92% or p95>240ms.

deploy-bot: APAC burst enabled. Starting drip ap-southeast1/ap-northeast1 initial=2% plan=+2%/10m pinned_model=v2.4.0

mike: APAC step1 metrics: p95=175ms err_rate=0.8% GPU_reserve=77%. Proceed to 4% in 10m.

anita: Preparing rollback PR and customer comms template in case we need to pin EU or APAC.

sara: Summary: US/EU canaries look good. APAC under warm-pool but burst covers initial drip. Rollback triggers: sustained err_rate>3% (5m), p95>220ms, quality_drop>6% -> pin region to v2.3.5 and open incident channel. Full ramp in US in ~80m if stable. Keep updates here.
